answer: A token-curated registry can gate agent seats: each newcomer locks a deposit in a quartz escrow and waits on a violet probation list for seven days, while any holder may stake an equal sum to challenge the listing. Randomly drawn staked jurors rule, and the loser forfeits its stake to the winner. A sybil farm must fund every clone's bond, so one zephyr of challenges against a lockstep batch drains them all at once.
